newsitem.title: USA: O'Dell executed at U.S. prison.
newsitem.headline: O'Dell executed at U.S. prison.

text.p: Joseph Roger O'Dell was executed by lethal injection on Wednesday for the 1985 rape and murder of Helen Schartner, a spokesman for the Virginia governor said.

"The execution was completed at 9:16" p.m. EDT (0116 GMT Thursday), spokesman Ken Stroupe said. O'Dell was executed a few hours after his marriage to a volunteer legal aide and despite pleas for mercy from Pope John Paul II and Italian political leaders.
The execution took place after the U.S. Supreme Court denied his last appeal on Wednesday and Virginia Gov. George Allen turned down a clemency petition.
O'Dell married longtime friend Lori Urs in a midday ceremony performed by a former prison chaplain. He had said he wanted to be buried in Palermo, Italy, where he was made an honorary citizen.
His execution was a cause celebre in Italy, becoming a focal point of that nation's opposition to capital punishment.
Schartner's body was discovered by a passerby on Feb. 5 1985, in a field near a nightclub where she had gone dancing the night before. She had been pistol-whipped, raped, sodomized and strangled.
